findings.location: Paragraph containing quoted author account (source.html paragraph starting “My hymn was composed…”)
findings.source_quote: I am quite sure that the whole work was completed in five minutes and equally sure it never received at my hands any retouching or correction.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the entire quoted sentence into Hindi (keep it inside the same … structure). Replace the English word 'retouching' with an appropriate Hindi rendering (e.g., "छेड़-छाड़" / "संशोधन" / "सुधार") so the whole quoted passage is in target language. Preserve punctuation and the quote structure.
findings.translation_quote: मुझे पूरा विश्वास है कि पूरा कार्य पाँच मिनट में पूरा हुआ और उतना ही विश्वास है कि मेरे हाथों द्वारा इसे किसी प्रकार की retouching या संशोधन कभी स्वीकार नहीं हुआ।

Do not leave these quoted substantive titles in English text.
